item.title: Community Shield buildup, Championship and club friendly updates – matchday live
item.summary: ⚽ News and buildup to the first Sunday of the EFL season ⚽ Community Shield preview | Mail us “The Community Shield is a first opportunity to make some kind of assessment of whether Arsenal’s hunger is as sharp as it was last season, and of how City’s squad are adapting to their new manager. It is, though, a largely ceremonial occasion, any lessons drawn to be taken with extreme caution…” Today’s fixtures Arsenal v Manchester City Watford v Southampton Burnley v West Ham Racing Santander v Villarreal Espanyol v Levante Continue reading...
